citations.field: 半部 entry; printed p. 68, PDF p. 80; checked headword, component statement, cited examples, sense extensions, entry ending against attached scan pixels
citations.text: The entry identifies 半 as a semantic compound of 牛 and 八, explains 八 as ‘divide,’ and states that its original meaning is ‘one half, one of two equal parts.’ It cites 《易·繫辭下》‘知者觀其象辭，則思過半矣’ and 秦公簋 ‘大半升’ as uses of that meaning. It then says meanings such as ‘in the middle’ and ‘incomplete’ extend from ‘dividing an object.’ The passage ends on this page; no continuation is indicated. Edition metadata in the local corpus identifies the 2012 three-volume edition, Tianjin Guji Press and Liaoning People’s Press, ISBN 9787552800692. The original scan was inspected directly; the provisional OCR was used only as a locator and agrees with the cited wording.
